results.question: What is this document about?
results.answer: This document is RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics, published by the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) as STD 97 in June 2022. It describes the overall architecture of HTTP, establishes common terminology, and defines aspects of the protocol shared by all versions, including core protocol elements, extensibility mechanisms, and the "http" and "https" URI schemes. It updates RFC 3864 and obsoletes several earlier RFCs, including 2818, 7230, 7231, 7232, 7233, 7235, 7538, 7615, and 7694. [document]

results.question: What is the title of this document?
results.answer: The title of this document is "RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics" [document].
